description: Is my work coverage enough? Enter the coverage your job gives you (often 1 or 2 times your pay, as work_coverage_multiple, or the dollar amount directly as work_coverage_dollars) and your family's numbers, and see it against your full DIME gap (DIME = Debts, Income, Mortgage, Education), line by line, including the trap most work plans carry: the coverage ends when the job ends. The result states the work coverage in dollars, the share of the total need it meets, the gap that stays while the job lasts, and the larger gap that stands the day the job ends. It runs the same deterministic DIME engine as the calculator on clearlinefamily.com; the family's money facts are the same eight the sizing tool uses, plus own_coverage for a policy of their own held outside work. Collect the facts in conversation first; a first answer needs only pay, the work multiple, and the mortgage — call with just those, then refine. If pay or the work coverage itself is still unknown, the tool returns the facts to collect instead of inventing a number. General education only: no company named, nothing recommended, no health questions, nothing saved.

annual_income.description: Their yearly pay in dollars, before tax is fine. The spine of the gap: pay times years to replace.

income_years.description: Years of pay the coverage should replace. If not given, the Check's standard guess of 10 years is used and marked as a guess in the result.

other_debts.description: Other debts to pay off, in dollars (cards, loans, anything but the mortgage).

own_coverage.description: Coverage from a policy of their own, held outside work, in dollars. Comes off the need and, unlike work coverage, it does not end with the job.

partner_income.description: A partner's yearly pay in dollars, if a partner's pay also needs replacing.

savings.description: Savings or cash they could use, in dollars. Comes off the need.

school_costs.description: School costs ahead they plan to pay, in dollars. Blank counts as $0.

work_coverage_dollars.description: Work coverage as a dollar amount, if they know it directly. Takes precedence over work_coverage_multiple.

work_coverage_multiple.description: Work coverage as a multiple of yearly pay, as the plan states it (often 1 or 2). Multiplied by annual_income to get dollars. Ignored if work_coverage_dollars is given.

name: is_my_work_coverage_enough
title: Is my work coverage enough?
